assumptions: cw-ssim -> cw_ssim::score (cw_ssim.rs:229-249): BT.601 rounded luma -> complex 2D FFT (cw_fft::transform) -> fftshift -> radial lo-masks + 3 centre crops to level W/8 x H/8 -> 8 oriented bands (angular mask order 7 x (-i)^7 phase -> ishift -> iFFT) -> CW-SSIM similarity 2*|sum re + j sum im| / sum energy on valid 7x7 box, Gaussian weight sigma=BH/4, K=0; score = mean of 8 orientations.
FFT flops: complex radix pass ~5mul+5add per elem per log2 level per axis -> mul/add 5*(log2W+log2H) per elem per transform (cw_fft.rs radix-2/Bluestein; Bluestein counted as radix-2 equivalent).
angle/radius grid (cw_ssim.rs:91-106): per elem atan2 + xx2+yy2 (2mul+1add) + sqrt + log2 + freq div/cvt; computed once but stage covers both imgs' mask multiply.
Radial mask interpolate (cw_ssim.rs:13-17,107-130): per elem div+floor(cvt)+3 mul/add + 2 complex muls; applied at level0 + 3 crops + hi-mask.
band() (cw_ssim.rs:133-160): per elem interpolate + radial mul + 2 complex muls + shift gather + iFFT at BW x BH.

similarity() (cw_ssim.rs:185-228): per elem products (real 2mul1add, imag 2mul1sub, energy 4mul3add) + 3x box7 running sums (~5add/elem each) + pool per valid elem (weight 2mul+1add+div+exp, q cmp+2mul+add+sqrt+mul+div, fma+add).
